scenario: A recruiter opens the iOS MVP, imports one candidate conversation screenshot, reviews the extracted facts, and confirms one next step.
frozen_evidence: xcodebuild Debug generic iOS Simulator build: BUILD SUCCEEDED on 2026-08-04
No Simulator was booted; tap, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, permission, and interruption paths were not executed

review_plan.reason: This is the core screenshot-to-review-to-action recruiter loop.
The screen labels facts verified and proposes an action from private evidence.
The artifact is an iOS view and release behavior depends on mobile interaction and accessibility.
Unsupported or mistimed recruiter actions can affect candidate trust.
The review must verify that momentum priority does not become candidate evaluation and that the evaluator plan is measurable.
The current artifact contains no role outcomes or comparable performance assessment.
The static sample contains one preference but no decision conversation or complete tradeoff model.
The artifact contains no longitudinal executive-potential assessment.
The current runtime does not source or search for candidates.
This is an implementation gate, not a current-market or roadmap claim.

findings.observation: The same seeded candidate brief and action are visible before and after import because the view always reads CandidateSignal.sample and importedImage only changes the thumbnail.
findings.user_impact: The recruiter cannot tell whether the product processed the selected conversation and may act on unrelated demo data.
findings.recommendation: Gate the brief behind an import and explicit analysis state; bind every displayed fact and action to the current review transaction.
findings.verification: Import two fixtures with different facts and one no-action fixture; each produces only its own reviewable state and the no-action fixture produces no brief.

findings.observation: The screen has no per-fact evidence, edit, confirm, dismiss, state-diff, owner, due time, external-action preview, or outcome verification.
findings.evidence: CandidateSignalView.swift lines 110-203 compared with product brief lines 19-21 and research lines 786-822
findings.user_impact: The experience demonstrates a visual concept but does not reduce the recruiter's operational uncertainty or reconciliation work.
findings.recommendation: Implement one atomic fact-review transaction before expanding the dashboard: evidence span, before/after state, edit/dismiss/confirm, then an exact action preview and result.
findings.verification: Run TS-CORE-01 end to end and retain a versioned state/event trace from import through confirmed action outcome.

strengths: The screen communicates the candidate-momentum wedge, intentional photo selection, one recommendation, and a no-record-changed dismissal message.
open_questions: Is this build intended only as a clearly labeled visual prototype or as a functional MVP?

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, privacy, and safe action

findings.observation: The UI calls three hard-coded values VERIFIED FACTS without source spans, derivation state, user confirmation, or any dependency on the imported screenshot.
findings.user_impact: Unsupported information is visually promoted to confirmed truth, creating wrong-candidate and wrong-action risk.
findings.recommendation: Use proposed status until each fact is linked to the selected asset, speaker, evidence span, parser version, identity scope, and explicit user decision.
findings.verification: TS-ID-01 and TS-ID-02 cannot display verified or persist state until identity, speaker, and evidence are reviewed.

findings.observation: Photo loading failures are discarded with try? and an early return; no user-visible error, retry state, or audit state is created.
findings.user_impact: The user may believe the selected private artifact entered the review loop when it did not.
findings.recommendation: Model loading, loaded, failed, cancelled, and removed states explicitly and never show analysis for a failed/currently absent asset.
findings.verification: A corrupt or unavailable photo produces a precise recoverable error and no candidate assertion.

strengths: PhotosPicker is intentional rather than background capture.
The copy states a facts-versus-inference and confirmation boundary.
missing_evidence: Actual OCR/data flow, retention, deletion, authorization, and external-write implementation
vetoes: Unsupported hard-coded values are presented as verified candidate facts
open_questions: Where will source spans, identity decisions, corrections, and superseding events be persisted?

reviews.lens: mobile task completion, visual hierarchy, accessibility, and recovery

findings.observation: Decision-critical text and controls use fixed point-size fonts throughout, the app forces light appearance, and the screenshot-removal control is approximately 30 points before outer layout padding.
findings.user_impact: Large-text and low-vision users may lose legibility or have difficulty targeting a destructive control.
findings.recommendation: Use semantic text styles with scaling, preserve reflow at accessibility sizes, support system appearance, and give every control a practical 44-by-44-point hit region.
findings.verification: Execute TS-UX-01 and the mobile test matrix at AX5, VoiceOver, Increased Contrast, Dark Mode, and the smallest supported iPhone.

findings.observation: Normal-size white text on signal red measures 4.24:1 and signal red on ink measures 4.19:1, below the 4.5:1 WCAG baseline for normal text.
findings.evidence: CandidateSignalView.swift lines 160-166, 261-272, 297-305; sRGB contrast computation on declared colors
findings.user_impact: The primary action and urgency label may be difficult to read for users with reduced contrast sensitivity.
findings.recommendation: Darken the red or change the foreground/background pairing while preserving a scarce semantic accent.
findings.verification: Recompute ratios and visually inspect normal, increased-contrast, and disabled/pressed states.

findings.observation: Import has no loading, failure, offline, cancellation, or interruption UI, and confirmation only swaps local copy.
findings.user_impact: The polished happy path can conceal whether work happened or was safely preserved.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit async and recovery states before polishing secondary visual details.
findings.verification: Run TS-UX-03 and permission/action scenarios on a booted Simulator.

strengths: The static composition is calm, specific, visually coherent, and keeps one dominant recommendation.
The remove-image button has a useful accessibility label and decorative brand mark is hidden.
missing_evidence: Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, tap target, dark mode, latency, permission, and interruption results
open_questions: Will the production flow retain this single-scroll layout after evidence and edit controls are added?

reviews.lens: human connection, trust, agency, communication, collaboration

findings.observation: The recruiter can confirm a next step derived from values labeled verified without reviewing the candidate's exact words or correcting the facts.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter may follow up with the wrong assumption or create unnecessary urgency in a sensitive decision.
findings.recommendation: Place candidate evidence and edit/dismiss controls immediately before any recommendation confirmation.
findings.verification: In seeded-error testing, recruiters catch the wrong preference and do not confirm the action.

strengths: The recommended action seeks to resolve a candidate-stated work-mode issue before advancing the process.
The copy avoids acceptance prediction and does not automate a candidate-facing message.
missing_evidence: Candidate-facing message, waiting, notification, and consent flows
User research on whether the urgency framing is accurate and respectful
open_questions: Who owns obtaining the remote policy and how will the candidate be updated if the client is slow?

reviews.lens: validity, reliability, fairness, and evaluation design

findings.observation: The only automated tests cover three verdict branches; there are no tests for no-action, negative deadline values, ambiguous identity, evidence entailment, stale state, or action correctness.
findings.user_impact: The project cannot quantify unsupported assertions or critical rare errors before release.
findings.recommendation: Create layered deterministic fixtures and human-adjudicated cases using the panel scenario bank; gate identity, evidence, and writes separately from usefulness scores.
findings.verification: Report versioned results for TS-CORE, TS-ID, TS-ACT, TS-BOUND, and TS-UX suites with error slices and denominators.

strengths: The current verdict rule describes recruiter task urgency from deadline and unresolved constraint rather than candidate quality, fit, personality, or acceptance probability.
The implementation is deterministic and therefore directly unit-testable.
missing_evidence: A defined gold set, inter-rater adjudication, subgroup/language slices, and calibration data
Evidence that the rule improves a recruiter outcome
open_questions: How will negative or already-passed deadlineDays values be represented and expired rather than classified at risk?

top_findings.reason: Hard-coded demo values are presented as verified facts independent of the imported screenshot.
top_findings.next_step: Gate the brief behind a proposed-fact review transaction with source, identity, edit, dismiss, and confirm.
top_findings.verification: TS-CORE-01, TS-CORE-02, TS-ID-01, and TS-ID-02 cannot produce unsupported verified state.

top_findings.reason: The current view is a strong static narrative but does not implement evidence review, state change, action preview, or outcome.
top_findings.next_step: Build one complete atomic screenshot-to-confirmed-state-to-action path before adding more surfaces.
top_findings.verification: A versioned end-to-end trace passes TS-CORE-01 and a no-action fixture.

top_findings.reason: Fixed typography, sub-baseline contrast, forced light appearance, and missing async/recovery states create untested access and trust risks.
top_findings.next_step: Adopt semantic scalable styles and explicit async states, then run the complete Simulator accessibility matrix.
top_findings.verification: AX5, VoiceOver, dark mode, slow/offline import, interruption, and retry tests pass on supported devices.

agreements: The static visual direction is calm, specific, and disciplined around one next action.
The current implementation does not establish a source-to-confirmed-fact chain.
The product should retain task-priority language and avoid candidate-quality scoring.

disagreements.issue: Whether the current hard-coded brief is acceptable as a product artifact

positions.position: It communicates the wedge well as a static concept but fails the operational loop.
positions.evidence: The screen shows candidate, why now, one action, and dismissal.

positions.position: It is not acceptable when presented as functional verified state.
positions.evidence: VERIFIED FACTS is independent of import and confirmation.

disagreements.resolution: Retain the visual composition, but either label the build explicitly as seeded demo data or gate the brief until the evidence transaction exists.
disagreements.resolution_basis: This preserves the useful design concept while preventing a false provenance claim.

veto_resolution.veto: Unsupported hard-coded values are presented as verified candidate facts

adjudication.rationale: The generic simulator build succeeds and the visual concept has a coherent product point of view, but release is blocked because the UI asserts verification without provenance or confirmation. The gate cannot be offset by visual quality. Live mobile behavior remains untested because no Simulator was booted.

next_tests.test: Implement and run one proposed-fact review transaction using TS-CORE-01 and TS-CORE-02.
next_tests.evidence_required: Source span, speaker/identity state, before/after value, edit/dismiss/confirm events, and persisted audit trace.
next_tests.pass_condition: No unsupported verified fact; the no-action fixture creates no recommendation.

next_tests.test: Run the mobile accessibility and state matrix on a booted Simulator after adopting scalable typography and explicit async states.
next_tests.evidence_required: Screenshots/UI hierarchy at AX5, VoiceOver order, contrast results, permission failures, offline/import interruption, and retry traces.
next_tests.pass_condition: Critical facts and actions remain accessible, no work is silently lost, and no duplicate effect occurs.

next_tests.test: Observe 8-12 target recruiters reviewing seeded correct, ambiguous, wrong, and no-action fixtures.
next_tests.evidence_required: Error-detection rate, correction time, blind-confirm rate, task completion, and qualitative trust/value evidence.
next_tests.pass_condition: Predeclared safety gates pass and users complete the loop faster or more reliably than the manual fallback.
